name: Obsidian Atelier
promise: A private viewing: each work hangs alone on a wall with its label and catalogue number, and the rest of the collection on one salon wall.
description: A gallery composition. The entrance is one wall with the signature work hung on it beside its wall label and catalogue number. The rooms that follow hang the signature and the featured works one to a room, each mounted for its medium: a screen on the wall, a folio in a vitrine. The rest of the works hang on one salon wall, a bay for each works section, writing among them as its own destination, and the practice, the record, and the ways to get in touch are galleries under their own signage. The plan of the exhibition is the footer and the Index, so every section is two actions from anywhere. Each room has plain previous and next links by catalogue number, and nothing needs motion, hover, or JavaScript to read or reach. Its colors are the selected color scheme's, never the composition's.
